messages:
lina: Heads-up — pen-test intake dropped. PDF and quick summary in the bucket: s3://redwood-pt-intake/CR-2026-03/intake.pdf. Top priority issues: CR-17 (broad service IAM + passrole), CR-22 (prod using staging KMS alias), CR-30 (replayer missing write events).

rob: grabbing the file now. are there PoC steps in the report?

lina: yes, PoC for CR-17 shows privilege escalation via AssumeRole chaining. CR-22 shows terraform var accidentally populated with alias/pt-staging instead of alias/pt-prod. CR-30 lists missing audit entries between 2026-02-10 and 2026-02-14.

ajay: for RBAC: immediate mitigation = restrict the service principal to specific actions (iam:PassRole only for exact role ARNs, not wildcard). I'll prepare a scoped policy and PR.

megan: audit team can backfill 45 days and enable more granular event types. question: do we want to include schema-level hashes in the logs for evidence? makes tamper detection easier.

lina: yes include schema hash. evidence format: s3://evidence.redwood.ai/pt/CR-2026-03/<component>/proof-<timestamp>.ndjson.gz. Vendor needs proofs by 2026-04-05 EOD; we're tentatively requesting retest 2026-04-06 -> 2026-04-08.

rob: KMS plan note: because alias was wrong, some decrypts were happening with the staging key in prod pool. rotation required. I'll draft rotation runbook; need ops window. blast radius = low-medium (most services support key alias fallback).

ajay: quick RBAC change estimate: PR + reviews + staged rollout = 4 hours. will include audit for who can create roles going forward.

megan: backfill ETA depends on log size, but 45 days should be ~36h of processing. we'll upload signed proof bundle with the query and checksum.

lina: owners: RBAC = ajay, KMS = rob, Audit = megan. I'll add owners to the PT ticket PT-900 (https://issues.redwood.ai/PT-900).

rob: rotation runbook draft:
```
# KMS rotation quick plan
1) create new KMS key in prod (alias/pt-2026-04-rotate)
2) set key policy to allow only kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:ReEncryptForReplica for the service principal
3) update terraform with new alias and run plan in canary namespace
4) apply to 10% canary, run decrypt/encrypt smoke tests
5) wave to 50% then 100% with 15m monitoring windows
6) if error rate >3% rollback alias pointer to old key and open incident channel
```

megan: add to that: capture KMS CloudTrail events and snapshot the grant table before change. we'll include the grant snapshot in the evidence bundle.

ops-bot: Ops reminder: KMS rotation canary apply scheduled for 2026-03-31T09:00:00Z in #eng-oncall.

lina: remediation board: https://kanban.redwood.ai/board/PT-900 — will create lanes: triage / fix-in-progress / evidence / ready-for-retest. please move cards.

rob: estimate timeline if we start 2026-03-29: RBAC PR merged by 2026-03-29 EOD, KMS rotation complete by 2026-03-31, audit backfill proofs uploaded by 2026-04-02. that meets vendor evidence deadline of 2026-04-05.

ajay: RBAC PR link will be posted in an hour. will include a temporary policy to revoke iam:CreatePolicy for non-admins to avoid accidental wide roles.

megan: evidence format note: each proof bundle must include a signed manifest.json with SHA256 checksums and the query used. we'll also include a replay script that shows event reconstruction.

lina: OPS signal: if any downstream service logs >2% failure after rotation, pause rollout and escalate. rob sam will own the rollback (rob = key ops, sam = oncall).

rob: I'll plant a canary flag and health endpoint checks. smoke script: ./tools/kms-smoke.sh --target canary. will upload logs to evidence path on success.

ajay: will add automated CI check to block merges that contain iam:* in service role creations. short-term exception process: create a ticket and get two approvals.

megan: uploading initial proof skeleton to evidence bucket now (partial) — link: s3://evidence.redwood.ai/pt/CR-2026-03/skeleton/manifest.json

lina: great. final pre-retest checklist I want ticked before we ping vendor:
- RBAC scoped and merged (owner: ajay)
- KMS alias rotated and grants validated (owner: rob)
- Audit backfill complete + proof bundle uploaded (owner: megan)
- CI/Lint guard added for iam:* (owner: ajay)
- Dry-run successful on staging and canary (owner: rob)

megan: I'll upload final proofs by 2026-04-02 18:00Z. if anything slips, i'll update here.

lina: thanks team — i'll update PT-900 and confirm retest slot with vendor once proofs are in. if blockers surface, post here and tag @lina. :white_check_mark:
